# MDL201 · `unknown-group`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

A group that neither mydumper, myloader nor the MySQL client library reads.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | groups |
| Default severity | warning |
| Fix | — |
| Design references | §3.6 |

## Why

mydumper reads [mydumper], myloader reads [myloader], both read their per-product groups ([mydumper_mysql_8_0]), their variable groups ([mydumper_session_variables]) and table sections ([`db`.`table`]); the MySQL client library reads [client]. Any other group is silently ignored, keys included. [mydumper_variables] and [myloader_variables] were renamed [*_session_variables] in v0.14.0-1.

## Example

❌ Before:

```ini
[mydumpr]
threads=4
[mydumper_variables]
sql_mode=x
[mydumper_oracle]
threads=2
[mysqldump]
quick=1
```

```text
1:2-1:9 warning MDL201[unknown-group] [mydumpr] is read by nobody: did you mean [mydumper]?
  = Every key of this group is ignored.
3:2-3:20 warning MDL201[unknown-group] [mydumper_variables] is read by nobody: it was renamed [mydumper_session_variables] in v0.14.0-1
  = Every key of this group is ignored.
5:2-5:17 warning MDL201[unknown-group] [mydumper_oracle] is read by nobody: the product is not one mydumper knows (mysql, percona, mariadb, tidb, rds, google, clickhouse, dolt, unknown)
  = Every key of this group is ignored.
7:2-7:11 warning MDL201[unknown-group] [mysqldump] is read by nobody
  = Every key of this group is ignored.
```

## Configuration

Enabled by default. To change its severity or turn it off:

```yaml
rules:
  severity:
    MDL201: warning   # or error, info, off
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL201` on the line above it.
